**Chain walked (per L3 SOP: complaint first → pruned workload → mechanism event → config face):**

**1. Symptom side (the complaint).** Probing the services: `frontend (10.68.63.235:80) open — Connection Succeeded`, but `checkoutservice:5050 — Connection Failed`. So the unreachable unit is narrow: **one business service is down, the rest of the mesh is healthy** — "partial" unreachability. Alerts showed no metric anomalies (ruling out latency/CPU/memory classes).

**2. Object layer, pruned.** The pods listing has exactly one outlier row:

```
checkoutservice-7bbc84d447-gfr6r   0/1   ErrImagePull   0   30s   worker-03
```
All other 10 services are `1/1 Running`. The deployments listing confirms `checkoutservice 0/1 ... AVAILABLE 0` while every other deployment is `1/1`. Node worker-03 also hosts healthy pods (cartservice, frontend, recommendationservice, shippingservice), so node/network-level causes are excluded.

**3. Mechanism event (pod events, verbatim).**
```
Normal   Scheduled  Successfully assigned boutique/checkoutservice-7bbc84d447-gfr6r to worker-03
Normal   Pulling    Pulling image "ghost-registry.example.net/google-samples/microservices-demo/checkoutservice:v0.10.3"
Warning  Failed     Failed to pull image "...": failed to resolve reference "...": dial tcp: lookup ghost-registry.example.net on 127.0.0.53:53: no such host
Warning  Failed     Error: ErrImagePull  →  ImagePullBackOff
```
Because the container never starts, the pod is never Ready → the `checkoutservice` Service has no ready endpoint → the caller path fails. This is the exact break point: **image pull / name resolution of the referenced registry**, not scheduling (Scheduled OK), not admission (no FailedCreate), not mounts/probes.

**4. Config face (the reference the mechanism points at).** Comparing image lines across workloads:

| service | image |
|---|---|
| frontend, cartservice (and the other 9) | `us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/google-samples/microservices-demo/…:v0.10.3` |
| **checkoutservice** | **`ghost-registry.example.net/google-samples/microservices-demo/checkoutservice:v0.10.3`**  ← `# Injected fictional domain` |
